method: Read-only live pg_proc/pg_class/pg_attribute + non-sensitive effective role privileges and ACL text; ordered complete rows with source signatures; semantic classification per ACL object; historical full routine sources are previous distinct review, not credited again.
query:
WITH f AS (
SELECT n.nspname s,p.proname n,pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid) args,pg_get_userbyid(p.proowner) owner,p.prosecdef definer,p.proconfig config,p.proacl::text acl,has_schema_privilege('anon',n.oid,'USAGE') asu,has_schema_privilege('authenticated',n.oid,'USAGE') hsu,has_function_privilege('anon',p.oid,'EXECUTE') ae,has_function_privilege('authenticated',p.oid,'EXECUTE') he,md5(pg_get_functiondef(p.oid)) body_md5 FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace WHERE n.nspname IN ('public','private')),
t AS (
SELECT n.nspname s,c.relname n,c.relkind k,c.relrowsecurity rls,c.relacl::text acl,has_schema_privilege('anon',n.oid,'USAGE') asu,has_schema_privilege('authenticated',n.oid,'USAGE') hsu,has_table_privilege('anon',c.oid,'SELECT') ar,has_table_privilege('authenticated',c.oid,'SELECT') hr,has_table_privilege('anon',c.oid,'INSERT') ai,has_table_privilege('authenticated',c.oid,'INSERT') hi,has_table_privilege('anon',c.oid,'UPDATE') au,has_table_privilege('authenticated',c.oid,'UPDATE') hu,has_table_privilege('anon',c.oid,'DELETE') ad,has_table_privilege('authenticated',c.oid,'DELETE') hd,md5(coalesce(c.relacl::text,'DEFAULT')) acl_md5 FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE c.relkind IN('r','p','v','m','f','S') AND n.nspname NOT LIKE 'pg_%' AND n.nspname <> 'information_schema'),
c AS (
SELECT n.nspname s,cls.relname r,a.attnum no,a.attname col,format_type(a.atttypid,a.atttypmod) ty,a.attnotnull nn,a.attacl::text acl,has_schema_privilege('anon',n.oid,'USAGE') asu,has_schema_privilege('authenticated',n.oid,'USAGE') hsu,has_table_privilege('anon',cls.oid,'SELECT') atr,has_table_privilege('authenticated',cls.oid,'SELECT') htr,has_column_privilege('anon',cls.oid,a.attnum,'SELECT') acr,has_column_privilege('authenticated',cls.oid,a.attnum,'SELECT') hcr,md5(concat_ws('|',n.nspname,cls.relname,a.attnum,a.attname,format_type(a.atttypid,a.atttypmod),a.attnotnull::text,coalesce(a.attacl::text,'DEFAULT'))) sig FROM pg_attribute a JOIN pg_class cls ON cls.oid=a.attrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=cls.relnamespace WHERE a.attnum>0 AND NOT a.attisdropped AND cls.relkind IN('r','p','v','m','f') AND n.nspname NOT LIKE 'pg_%' AND n.nspname <> 'information_schema')
SELECT jsonb_build_object('functions',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(f) ORDER BY s,n,args) FROM f),'relations',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(t) ORDER BY s,n,k) FROM t),'columns',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(c) ORDER BY s,r,no) FROM c)) AS dataset;
